verdict.rationale: Kit is an email platform, so separating transactional from marketing sending is a fair question for it. The evidence covers only marketing broadcasts, sequences, segmentation and account-level sending addresses. Nothing documents a transactional stream with its own templates, suppression rules or reputation, or delivery of receipts to unsubscribed contacts.

support.subject: As an ops user, transactional email is kept separate from marketing — its own templates, suppression rules, and reputation — so a receipt still delivers to an unsubscribed contact
